name: Lundberg Organic White Jasmine Rice (Steamed Fluffy)
whyItWorks: The undisputed foundational carbohydrate for Crohn's and Colitis patients worldwide. Completely polished long-grain white rice is hypoallergenic, has virtually 0g insoluble fiber, absorbs smoothly, and provides immediate clean energy to heal intestines.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Rinse rice until water runs clear. Cook 1 cup rice in 1.75 cups water with a pinch of sea salt for 15 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
watchOuts: The safest carbohydrate staple in gastroenterology.
